title: Build once, run on any agent: A practical guide to agent skills
content: Agent skills are versioned directories containing a SKILL.md file that captures repeatable task instructions for AI agents. They separate project configuration from logic, utilizing shared manifests to maintain portability and consistency. By coordinating multiple skills for complex workflows, teams can standardize processes like data pipeline creation and code verification. Skills guide agent behavior and define approval checkpoints, while the execution environment provides necessary tools and credentials. This approach enables teams to build reusable, portable workflows that adapt to different agent clients without rewriting core instructions.

title: Deploy frontier AI models on AWS Trainium with SGLang-Neuron
content: Amazon has released SGLang-Neuron, a publicly available AWS Deep Learning Container that enables SGLang deployment on AWS Trainium. Created by RadixArk and Annapurna Labs, it uses a native PyTorch architecture to serve AI models and generate reinforcement learning rollouts. The plugin integrates Trainium as a standard PyTorch device, managing model execution and attention while preserving SGLang’s core API and scheduling. Users can launch the service via Docker on Trainium EC2 instances, utilizing features like PD disaggregation and the Neuron Kernel Interface to maintain the familiar SGLang workflow.
